blind.description: A stylized ceremonial vestment or robe displayed on a wooden mannequin/stand. The stand consists of a turned circular wooden base, a vertical pole topped with a spherical finial, and a horizontal crossbar supporting the shoulders. Draped over it is a full-length cream-colored robe with deep folds, accented by a broad golden-yellow hem and a central vertical stole, topped with a deep maroon/reddish-brown capelet trimmed in gold. The geometry is clean, solid, and continuous with stylized hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: From straight above, it resembles a fluted or scalloped oval mantle with a central wooden sphere and horizontal shoulder bar, showing the deep maroon capelet with yellow trim curving around the neck and flaring out at the sides.
blind.extra_base_or_ground: circular turned wooden stand base (integral to the model)
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.3 feet tall (roughly three-quarters the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2 feet wide at the base of the flared robe.
